slides.section: ScholarClone - Verified product facts (from the product page)
slides.title: Solutions

content.body: The shift each product makes, with the value it brings. One row per product.
bullets: Scholar One (Integrated Intelligent School Platform): from "Disconnected school information" to "Connected school information". Value: One login, one set of records, no re-entering data; Leaders see learning, staff and operations together.

Scholar Core (Intelligent School Operations): from "Manual administrative processes" to "Digitally managed workflows". Value: Fewer missed fees and faster collection follow-up; Admission enquiries tracked from first call to confirmation.

Scholar Learn (AI-Powered Personalised Learning): from "Same learning approach for everyone" to "Personalised learning pathways". Value: Gaps found early, concept by concept, not after the exam; Teachers see why a student is stuck, not just the marks.

Scholar CCB (Competence and Capability Intelligence): from "Limited visibility into teacher capabilities" to "Evidence-based capability intelligence". Value: Real skill gaps for each role, not guesses; Training matched to the gap and tracked to completion.

Scholar Insight (School Intelligence): from "Reports without connected insights" to "Better institutional intelligence". Value: One connected view across the whole school; Trace weak results back to the root concept.

Scholar Compass (Student Career Intelligence): from "Limited career guidance" to "Structured career intelligence". Value: Students understand their interests and strengths; Careers, sectors, courses and colleges to explore.

slides.section: ScholarClone - Verified product facts (from the product page)
slides.title: Scholar One

content.body: Integrated Intelligent School Platform. One intelligent platform connecting the entire school.
bullets: Problem it solves: Schools run five disconnected systems
Problem it solves: Leaders can’t connect learning, staff and operations

Why the customer needs it: Your school already runs on five separate things: the office, the classroom, the staffroom, the principal’s notebook and the counsellor’s file. Scholar One connects them into one intelligent school, so what happens in each room informs every decision.
Why the customer needs it: Best fit. Schools that want the full loop and a single partner. Others can start with one product and add the rest.
How ScholarClone addresses it: One platform, one login, shared records
How ScholarClone addresses it: Insight reads all of them; Learn and CCB share teacher data
Trustee / Principal needs: Institutional visibility, decision support and school performance.
Business value: One login, one set of records, no re-entering data
Business value: Leaders see learning, staff and operations together
Business value: A single rollout and a single partner instead of five vendors
Ask: Where does your school feel "disconnected school information" most today?

image.alt: Scholar One: Integrated Intelligent School Platform

Why the customer needs it: Best fit. Start here if your biggest pain is operations. Add Learn, CCB, Insight and Compass later on the same records.
How ScholarClone addresses it: Fee collection, cancel/refund, audit trail, online payment and scheduled reminders
How ScholarClone addresses it: Enquiry, follow-up, registration, form and confirmation in one flow
Trustee / Principal needs: Institutional visibility, decision support and school performance.
Teacher needs: Teaching support, assessment and capability development.
Parent needs: Fees, results, notices and attendance for their child.

Business value: Report cards and results prepared in one flow

Why the customer needs it: Best fit. Start here if your focus is learning outcomes. In Scholar One, Learn also feeds Insight, Compass and CCB.

How ScholarClone addresses it: Chapter diagnostic and concept-level results show gaps early

slides.section: ScholarClone - Verified product facts (from the product page)
slides.title: Customer questions

content.body: Straight answers, using what the product page says.
bullets: What does it cost? Say: Pricing depends on the products and the size of your school. We share it in a personal conversation after a short fit review.
Do we need all five products? Say: No. Start with the layer that fits your biggest problem and add more later. Scholar One is for schools that want the full loop on one platform.
How is rollout done? Say: A forward-deployed team works with your school through implementation. We do not install and leave.
Can parents pay fees online? Say: Yes. Online fee payment is available through your school’s payment gateway.
Is the content checked before students see it? Say: Yes. AI-tagged questions go through a review and approval step before they reach students.
How is our data protected? Say: We walk you through the data-protection controls in a personal conversation during the fit review.

options.text: Suggest a short fit review, then start with the one product that answers the biggest problem, and add the others later.
Agree a one-product start today, and promise a price for the other products right now so the school feels it is getting a deal.
Propose all five products on day one and say you will email one quote for everything.

slides.section: ScholarClone - Ending (fictional training scenario)
slides.title: Deal won

choice.text: A short fit review, then one product, the others later

interaction.what: The school agrees to a short fit review and a start with the one product that answers its biggest problem.
interaction.why: This follows how the product page says ScholarClone is sold: pricing depends on the products and the size of the school and is shared in a personal conversation after a short fit review, and a school can start with the layer that fits and add more later. A forward-deployed team then works with the school through rollout.

slides.section: ScholarClone - Ending (fictional training scenario)
slides.title: Won, with concessions

choice.text: Promised a price for the other products on the spot

interaction.what: The school agrees to a one-product start, but you have committed to a price before the fit review.
interaction.why: The product page says pricing is shared after a short fit review, because it depends on the products and the size of the school. A price promised early is a concession you may not be able to keep, and it weakens the review. Start with the fit review, then discuss price.

slides.section: ScholarClone - Ending (fictional training scenario)
slides.title: Deal stalled

choice.text: Five products on day one, one quote by email

interaction.what: The principal says the school will think about it, and the conversation goes quiet.
interaction.why: The product page is clear that a school does not need all five products: start with the layer that fits the biggest problem and add more later; Scholar One is for schools that want the full loop on one platform. Leading with everything hides the problem you were asked to solve.
